summary: Iteration 5 retest of the iteration 4 failures. Testing ran at 02:40 Sat 14 Nov 2026 Adelaide time, so current_slot was ('2026-11-13', 'evening'). This is the after-midnight case the fixes target. Backend: 62/62 tests pass (QuarterlyTest deselected). That includes the 3 tests that failed before plus a new one: the running session's date is not listed in /me/reminders or in dashboard unlogged_dates. checkins_today, the /admin/sessions default date and the POST /api/logs played_at default all use the session date (2026-11-13). One old test (iteration2 TestRaffleBonus current_progress) failed because the test itself seeded a check-in on the calendar date and then logged without played_at. I fixed the test by passing played_at explicitly; the app behaviour is correct. Frontend: all checks pass. The landing drink perk text is exactly as specified and no '1 x drink' text remains. A non-subscriber who paid for the day session sees 'Check in free', and the toast reads 'Checked in free – you already paid today'. No reminder banner appears for the running session. The Game Log dialog date defaults to 2026-11-13. Admin Check-ins shows Day '1 PERSON', Evening '1 PERSON' and the label 'Free · paid earlier today'. The Session summary tab defaults to 2026-11-13 and shows Checked in = 2.

ui_bugs.issue: admin-checkin-count hard-codes 'people' (Admin.js line 64: `{data?.headcount || 0} people`), so a headcount of 1 shows '1 PEOPLE'. Use plural(...).replace('persons','people') as the per-session counts do.

issues: The date filters are still native <input type=date> (browser picker), not the shadcn Calendar

The landing perk says the free drink/snack applies only 'during special member-wide free admission sessions', but the subscriber check-in toast says 'Checked in! Grab your free drink & snack.' and iteration 4 saw the panel note 'A free drink and snack included'. Confirm the intended wording.

action_items: Optional: line up the subscriber check-in toast/panel text with the new 'special sessions only' drink perk wording
critical_code_review_comments: The session-date fixes are consistent across admin_summary, session_summary, create_log and unlogged_checkins, and the frontend sessionDate() matches (hour<5 means the previous day).
Session summary 'Checked in' counts check-in rows, so one person attending both sessions counts as 2. This is likely intended; label it if not.
The dashboard still returns both today (session date) and today_date (calendar date). Fine, but easy to confuse.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested checks (1 low-priority pluralisation issue found in code review)

seed_data_creation: TEST_ users only (pytest fixtures plus ui_fixtures.py), with their data removed afterwards. 0 TEST_ users remain, 0 orphan check-ins and no TEST_ login_attempts. Nothing was paid on Square and Square requests were blocked in Playwright. quarter_awards was not touched.
